set.body: Track the follow-on least-squares hardening work after the QR-default OLS slice. Scope: package the current fit/linalg hardening cleanly, expose solver diagnostics, make rank-deficient behavior an explicit policy, add independent numerical oracle tests, document behavior changes, and run broad repo verification when the larger dirty tree is ready. Acceptance: each child slice is closed with focused evidence; the epic closes only after all six items are complete or deliberately superseded.
set.title: Epic: least-squares fit hardening phase 2
